operation.source_intent: CancelClickedAsync renders only when ShowCancel is true, suppresses the callback only while Busy or CancelDisabled, and otherwise invokes the supplied OnCancel callback.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The source-equivalent cancel action is mounted on the real tenant-scoped WordPress Site Onboarding final step. It honors ShowCancel, suppresses only Busy or cancelDisabled, and delegates to the existing Previous-step callback independently of the save de-duplication ref.
laravel_adaptation.authorization: The shared sync form-action control is rendered only for sites.manage (or *).

security_boundary.tenant_context: The mounted flow uses the server-authored active tenant FrontendContext and does not accept a caller-owned tenant selector.
security_boundary.external_state: Cancel performs local wizard navigation only and adds no WordPress, connector, queue, persistence, or HTTP mutation.
